full_test_suite.timing: Before confirmation lock; scientific sources unchanged since

limitations: Small designed task samples; bootstrap does not establish a powered population study.
Validation uses 256 observations even at 32 training observations; curves are not total-label budgets.
Training budgets and pilot-selected rates limit claims; no confirmation-driven retuning.
All B models have 49 trainable coefficients but different bases; learned banks have 16 kernels, fixed bank 48.
Fixed-kernel unregularized solves can be ill-conditioned with large coefficients; reproducibility is not coefficient accuracy.
VM peak kernels and chordal Gaussian RBFs are algebraically equivalent.
Noise-parity subgroups are confounded with task identity and are descriptive.
Exact arrays, states, full histories and locks remain ignored local artifacts; this compact record does not replace them.
Confirmation functions are consumed. New methodological selection requires a new protocol and unused seeds.
scope: Completed synthetic mechanism tests; no novelty, universal superiority or deployment claim
